dialogue.speaker: bro
dialogue.text: yo bro i found this cool game named "internet explorers"

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: oh yeah? whats it about?

dialogue.speaker: bro
dialogue.text: its this rpg where u fight off enemies and secure sectors of the internet

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: cool!!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: u go to a browser and open up internet explorers

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: its so cool that its all in a browser!!

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: well i just need to sign up then

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: you sign up, but then suddenly, a portal opens up and you get sucked into it.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: WAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: ok ur not THAT loud bro

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: mb narrator man
man, that guy just killed my entire team... well time to restart...

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: yo, who r u??
yo, im just the manager for this team.. im just struggling because of these enemies :(

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: yeah i can tell, but like whats ur name and stuff

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: oh right mb, im D.Y.L.A.N

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: oh so ur a clanker?

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: yeah, i just wanna get through these enemies and secure this sector, u mind being the manager now??

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: aight bet

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: dude ur such a life saver, ur literally a gift from...

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: from what...? god?

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: yeah, from our lord and savior hatsune miku..

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: what.

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: anyways lets get going, these enemies wont take themselves out!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: dude i dont even know how to play this game...

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: oh right im the tutorial guy i completely forgot

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: basically just drag and drop. you will see an arrow from your character to the enemy you want to attack.

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: if the character you selected is a healer, then instead of an enemy, you must select a teammate to heal.

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: there is no need to use all of your characters, but be mindful! they can still be attacked by enemies.

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: when you are done selecting, just press the big giant button you see.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: aight i think i can deal with that

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: great! lets go fight these guys!!

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: yoo nice job bro

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: dude i have a lot of questions, like what does rolling mean and what ignoring and stuff?

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: oh right i forgot about those, basically rolling means you roll a dice to determine if your character or enemy hits

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: ohhhhhh

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: and ignoring means that the enemy just attacks you no matter what, so you have to trade damage with them

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: dang thats rough

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: yeah tell me about it, but hey you did great for your first time!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: i still have more questions tho

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: dont worry you will learn it as we go on, its like learning mandarin

dialogue.speaker: D.Y.L.A.N
dialogue.text: well let's move on to the next stage!!
